items.key_concept: C5 binding prevents cleavage to C5a/C5b and terminal C5b-9 complex formation while the underlying GPI-anchor-deficient PNH clone remains unchanged
items.second_answer_attack: Restoring CD59 could theoretically protect erythrocytes, but the stem explicitly states that the abnormal GPI-anchored surface-protein phenotype persists; only complement C5 blockade explains benefit without clonal correction.

items.key_concept: inhibition of the CMV DNA terminase complex impairs viral DNA processing and packaging required for mature virion formation
items.verified_locator: 1.1 CMV Prophylaxis in HSCT Recipients; 12.4 Microbiology — Mechanism of Action
items.second_answer_attack: Direct DNA-polymerase inhibition can reduce CMV replication, but the stipulated genome-processing/packaging defect and defective virion maturation uniquely identify the terminase complex.

items.key_concept: PARP inhibition and PARP-DNA complex formation create DNA-repair stress that is especially cytotoxic in homologous-recombination-deficient cells
items.verified_locator: 1 Indications and Usage; 12.1 Mechanism of Action
items.second_answer_attack: Topoisomerase inhibition also causes DNA damage but is not the direct molecular target of olaparib; the named drug and BRCA/HR-deficient context select PARP inhibition.

items.key_concept: inhibition of susceptible mutant IDH1 lowers the oncometabolite 2-hydroxyglutarate and permits myeloid differentiation
items.revision_interpretation: The current SPL has a later effective/version date, while the full prescribing-information highlights still explicitly display Revised: 10/2023. Under the candidate's declared revision_basis, 10/2023 is the correct PI revision metadata.
items.second_answer_attack: BCL-2 inhibition is a plausible AML drug mechanism but cannot explain the specific reduction in mutant-IDH1-derived 2-hydroxyglutarate and associated release of differentiation block.

items.key_concept: XPO1/exportin-1 inhibition blocks nuclear export and causes nuclear retention/accumulation of tumor-suppressor proteins
items.revision_interpretation: The current SPL effective/version date is later than the full prescribing-information revision. The PI highlights explicitly display Revised: 4/2026, which matches the candidate's declared revision_basis.
items.verified_locator: 1 Indications and Usage; 12.1 Mechanism of Action
items.second_answer_attack: Blocking nuclear import would not produce the documented mechanism of nuclear retention by preventing export; the direction of transport uniquely identifies XPO1-mediated nuclear export.
